description: The published criteria for the Memory Provenance Audit service (memory-provenance-audit/v1): the eight provenance checks C1-C8 plus C9 chain integrity, the input format adapters (Mem0, Zep/Graphiti, generic JSONL, hash-only), the verdict-line rule, the custody block and retention terms, and the pinned public test corpus identity (corpus, harness and the C13 self-grade fixture are published at https://exchangerebel.com/provenance/). Read these before paying - every verdict is reproducible from them. - no payment required: call directly without payment (no x402 challenge; this tool is free). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/provenance/criteria.
name: provenance_criteria
